title: Same question, other wording or language, falls to the no-model lane
what_happens: With no model, 21 of 120 rewrites of questions the code lanes answer (for example m01 order and polite forms, m02, m13 polite and Tamil, m16 Tamil, m21 Tamil) end in the no-model line, while the base or another rewrite is answered. Some run the other way: the English base has no code lane but the Tamil rewrite does (m01 and m11 and m14).
what_should_happen: The code lanes answer the same fact in every wording and language, or a live model is the only fallback and this is stated.
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/metamorphic.test.ts (test name starts with the id); keys listed in metamorphic.known.json
root_cause_guess: src/lib/thunai/quick.ts and plan.ts: lane coverage differs by phrasing

title: The same question gives different numbers in another language or order
what_happens: Both answers are given with confidence, but the figures differ: m18 stray animal complaints in Valasaravakkam gives 66 cases in English, 16 in Tamil and 4 in Tanglish; m23 fire complaints in Madhavaram 1 vs 5; m27 road complaints in Thiru-Vi-Ka-Nagar 4 vs 51; m21 lakes level gives readings in English and 2 cases in Tanglish; m03 which zone has the most severe gives a ranking in English and a case list in Tamil and Tanglish; m08, m12, m28 Tamil give a screen with no figures.
what_should_happen: One fact, one number, whatever the language.
repro: npx vitest run --config vitest.qa4.config.ts tests/qa/pass4/metamorphic.test.ts (test name starts with the id); the keys m03:ta m03:tanglish m08:ta m12:ta m18:ta m18:tanglish m21:tanglish m23:ta m27:ta m28:ta m29:ta
root_cause_guess: quick.ts zone and category detection differs per language (zone word, category word and the broad word water)

title: Word list entries match inside other words in the real data (static audit)
what_happens: Over 15285 titles, 8614 places and 35 categories: tree in street (lexicon.ts:76 TREES_PARKS and screens.ts:218), rain in drain (quick.ts:108, guard.ts:149, stagelocal.ts:186, agent.ts:268, pipeline.ts:721, screens.ts:20 and datasets.ts:409, 1725 titles), enna in Chennai (privacy.ts:52, gloss.ts:31, plan.ts:326), padi in Vyasarpadi (gloss.ts:14), kattu in Ekkattuthangal (gloss.ts:12), malai in Thirumalai (gloss.ts:15, quick.ts:108), pakkam inside place names ending in -pakkam (gloss.ts:63), illa in Muniyapillai (lexicon.ts:162), auth in unauthorised, rise in unauthorised (datasets.ts:236 and pipeline.ts:723), city in Peripheral. 237 of 1185 word-like patterns matched mid-word on real text. Most are only a risk when the matcher is run on a title or place; each needs a check of where it is run.
what_should_happen: Whole word matches, or Tamil stems that are checked by a Tamil aware boundary.
repro: node tests/qa/pass4/word-pattern-audit.mjs, then read docs/qa/pass4/evidence/word-patterns.md (from tests/qa/pass4/word-pattern-audit.mjs)
